data.summary: Muster Mobil GmbH informs Mara Beispiel that from 01.02.2026 the monthly base price of the tariff „Muster Allnet 10 GB“ rises from 19.99 € to 22.99 €, while all other services stay unchanged. Because the change is not only to the customer's benefit, a special right of termination applies.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly base fee of your tariff from 19.99 € to 22.99 €, starting 01.02.2026. Because this increase is not purely in your favour, German law gives you a special right to cancel the contract free of charge within the period stated in the letter, counted from when you received it; if you cancel, the contract would end at the earliest when the new price takes effect. If you do nothing, the higher price simply applies from the effective date. If you're happy with the tariff, no action is needed; if not, cancel in writing before the special cancellation window closes (the app will show the exact deadline).
